name: Staxx — Twitter Weekly Content Scheduler
description: Auto-post tweets on a schedule. Write 7 tweets once a week, Make posts them daily.

modules.label: 📋 Watch Tweets sheet for new rows

setup_instructions:
1. Create a Google Sheet with columns: date, tweet_text, status
2. Write 7 tweets in the 'tweet_text' column, set status to 'ready'
3. Connect Google Sheets and Twitter accounts in Make
4. Set scenario to run once per day at 10:00 AM EST

Sample tweets to populate the sheet:

1. 'Most OnlyFans creators leave $3-5K/year in missed tax deductions on the table. Camera gear, editing software, internet, home studio — all deductible. Made a checklist: staxx.site'

2. 'Built something: upload your OF dashboard screenshot → AI auto-categorizes everything → tells you what to save for quarterly taxes. staxx.site #buildinpublic'

3. 'The IRS charges ~8% penalty interest on missed quarterly tax payments. Deadlines: Apr 15 / Jun 15 / Sep 15 / Jan 15. I built Staxx (staxx.site) to track this automatically.'

4. '3 tax mistakes new OF creators make: 1) Not tracking platform fees as expenses 2) Not paying quarterly estimates 3) Mixing personal & business expenses. Fix all 3: staxx.site'

5. 'OnlyFans takes 20%. Patreon 8-12%. Fansly 20%. ManyVids 40%. That fee difference alone is worth tracking. staxx.site auto-calculates your real net across platforms.'

6. 'Week 1 building Staxx: shipped screenshot→transaction AI, 12-point write-off checklist, quarterly tax estimator. Now working on multi-platform support. Try it: staxx.site'

7. 'First user found $4,700 in missed write-offs. Lighting equipment. Home studio. Editing subscriptions. All deductible. Their reaction: I wish I knew this last year. staxx.site'
